provenance.source: new: 2026-10-24 real-host bug. In Claude Code 2.1.306 `!echo teh ` became `! echo the`, typed or in one burst: Claude names its shell mode only in the prompt hint (`! for shell mode`, sent with isDraft set), and the adapter read the hint only on an empty draft. The `!` never reaches the draft, so Claude reads `echo teh` and the cases are Claude's own
provenance.author: murmo

cases.note: Autocorrect leaves a shell command alone (phase 13: shell input is never prose).
The same when `!` and the command arrive in one read.
